authored_scope: Supported: random background (never 2/3/5), distinct column colours (2 and 3 allowed, 5 forbidden), 2-5 columns (default 3-5), per-column heights, 1-3 2-markers and 1-2 3-markers in random sampling (more if explicit and they fit), unmarked distractor columns, and grid height 9-30. Width runs from the column span up to 30, biased to 30, and the left offset is uniform over all fitting positions. Native fixtures are 30x30 with 4 columns at x=3. Other sizes, column counts and offsets are synthetic extensions. Not supported: other shapes, other slot spacings or stack pitches, markers not under a column, other marker colours, or columns that are not bottom-aligned.
authored_constraints: Every scene has at least one 2-marker and one 3-marker, so the output never equals the input.
Each column's height is at least 1. Every 3-column's height plus the summed 2-height fits within (height-5)//4+1 shapes, so the extension never leaves the grid.
Column colours are distinct, differ from the background and are never 5. The background is never 2, 3 or 5.
Stacked shapes are separated by a blank row and adjacent slots by a blank column, so shapes never merge under 4- or 8-connectivity.
Row h-2 is always blank, so marker bars never touch shapes. Adjacent bars are separated by one background cell.
All numeric controls must be ints (bools and floats are rejected with ValueError).
